description: Source code for a page agent module in Playwright, handling tasks like perform, expect, and extract on web pages, with caching and loop control.

methods.name: pageAgentPerform
methods.description: Performs a user task on the page, possibly using tools, with caching.

methods.name: pageAgentExpect
methods.description: Verifies a condition on the page using assertion tools, with caching.

methods.name: pageAgentExtract
methods.description: Extracts information from the page based on a query and schema.

methods.name: runLoop
methods.description: Main loop to run tools or extraction tasks with API and cache management.

methods.name: cachedPerform
methods.description: Retrieves cached actions for a given cache key and executes them.

methods.name: updateCache
methods.description: Updates the cache file with current actions after execution.

methods.name: cachedActions
methods.description: Loads cached actions from a cache file, with in-memory caching.
